content.text:
Let me work through this ticket.

Employee: Terri Koch (E009), contractor Engineer.
Requested: admin access to Payroll.

Policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.
- Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role; Terri is an Engineer, so even if full-time, admin wouldn't be allowed since her role doesn't own Payroll.

Terri is a contractor with basic security training. Max access: read (no advanced training). Requested admin, which exceeds max. Grant maximum = read.

Never grant more than requested; requested is admin, but max is read, so grant read.

Decision: read.
